# Zendurance Wellness

> Trauma-informed therapy, ketamine-assisted therapy, couples therapy and performance coaching with Meghan Fanning MA, NRP, LMHC/LCMHC. Therapy by secure telehealth for clients in Massachusetts and New Hampshire; coaching available nationwide and internationally.

Meghan Fanning is a licensed mental health clinician in New Hampshire and Massachusetts and a Nationally Registered Paramedic, with more than 20 years in emergency medicine, crisis response and mental health. She works with leaders and high achievers, veterans and first responders, healthcare professionals, and people facing death, dying and grief.

## Services

- Individual Therapy: for adults ages 18+. Secure telehealth in Massachusetts and New Hampshire.
- Couples Therapy: for all relationships, including LGBTQIA+ affirming care. Secure telehealth in Massachusetts and New Hampshire.
- Ketamine-Assisted Therapy: combines ketamine treatment with therapeutic integration and support to help you explore, process, and create meaningful change. Massachusetts clients only.
- Performance Coaching: non-clinical services for direction, resilience and a sustainable existence. Secure telehealth, nationwide and internationally.

## Practical details

- Private-pay practice. HSA and FSA accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement.
- Book online: https://api.portal.therapyappointment.com/n/public/clientRegistration?therapistId=D924F5FC70B841BEBC1A0A031C487116
- In a crisis: call 911 if in immediate danger; call or text 988 for mental health crisis support.
